Summary: Faithfulness in Scripture almost always meets opposition: Nehemiah's wall-builders held a trowel in one hand and a sword in the other, Daniel's enemies plotted against his prayers, and the apostles were ordered to stop speaking in Jesus' name. Opposition is not a sign that God has abandoned his work; often it is the sign that the work matters. God's people answer it with prayer, courage, and steady obedience, trusting the Lord who builds what no enemy can tear down.
RelatedEvents: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall; Martyrdom of Stephen
